Subject: SOC 2 Type II access for auditor + bridge letter request

Hi Jonas,

We're starting the final review for our Q2 diligence and need short-term access to Redwood's SOC 2 Type II evidence bundle for the audit period Nov 1, 2026 — Apr 30, 2027. Our external auditor (Audit Partners) would like a timeboxed staging link with download enabled for a maximum of 48 hours.

Can you: 
- Provision a short-lived staging link (S3 pre-signed or trust portal shortlink) for one auditor?
- Confirm whether downloads are allowed on the temporary link or if we need a separate transfer method for zipped artifacts?
- Provide a dated bridge letter that references the above audit period and attests to no material changes since the report issuance (sample language is fine).

Auditor details: Tom Santos (tom.santos@auditpartners.net).

I've attached a preliminary evidence list so we can align on scope. Please loop in whoever owns auditor provisioning on your side. We prefer the window the week of May 24 if possible.

Thanks,
Olivia Bennett
Director, Vendor Risk
Equinox Ventures

Attachment: requested_evidence_list.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II access for auditor + bridge letter request

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and the evidence list. Quick clarifying items before we provision anything: 

1) Access window: we can do a 48-hour timeboxed shortlink (pre-signed S3 link behind the trust portal) or a 7-day portal guest account with view-only by default. For zipped downloads we can enable download for the shortlink only; portal guest accounts are typically view-only unless we grant explicit export permission.

2) Audit artifacts: are you expecting full report PDFs + raw artifacts (logs, config snapshots, deployments manifests) or only SOC 2 report + control test summary? The more we surface, the more likely we need an approval step from Security.

3) Bridge letter: we can provide a signed bridge letter dated the day the link is issued referencing the Nov 1, 2026 — Apr 30, 2027 period. Do you need it on Redwood letterhead and signed by our Security Lead?

If you confirm auditor email (tom.santos@auditpartners.net), I'll coordinate with Kimberly to create the link and draft the bridge letter. If you want the week of May 24, we can prepare the artifacts and issue the link on May 24th at 09:00 PT — 48 hours expiry -> May 26th 09:00 PT.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
